dedupe_keys.name: consommation finale cf en gaz naturel

description: Consommation finale (CF) en gaz naturel is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by IWEPS. The municipal energy indicators presented here are calculated for the municipal balance sheets of the SPW Territory, Housing, Heritage, Energy. Note: Communal balance sheets involve the use of aggregated communalized data, requiring the formulation of various hypotheses. Refer to the methodological note for more information. Coverage: IWEPS. The portal shows the English title as "Final consumption (FC) of natural gas" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is IWEPS. Its keywords include Consommation d-énergie, production d-énergie, Énergie. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2026-03-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
